t_advice_summary_textbox.text: use the x1 multiplier rounds to decide which is the right gnome to choose for when the 5x rounds appear. If unsure go left for 1x and right for 5x.

vb_textbox.text: For the 1x rounds test out the gnomes to see which gnome yields a higher reward. Then use this information to form your decision in the 5x rounds. If you are unsure go left for 1x and right for 5x. Also do not be afraid to experiment and shift when the rewards start to change. It can help to select your favourite variation of gnome and stick with them when they appear.
